newsitem.title: EGYPT: Nile tourist cruiser sinks, 20 feared drowned.
newsitem.headline: Nile tourist cruiser sinks, 20 feared drowned.

text.p: A Nile cruiser carrying 83 tourists sank in the Nile near the south Egyptian tourist resort of Aswan on Thursday and at least 20 people are missing, feared drowned, security sources said.
The boat, identified by police as the Amira Jihan, listed and sank off the town of Edfu, some 600 km (360 miles) south of Cairo, while travelling down the Nile from Aswan to Luxor, they said.
The cause of the accident was not known.
Officials at Aswan provincial headquarters said the boat was carrying Czech tourists. The security sources said they were of mixed nationalities.
